_comment: High/critical advisories in PRODUCTION dependencies that were judged unreachable and accepted. The reasoning is in CLAUDE.md, 'Accepted residuals'. Every entry needs a reason and a date. The Security workflow fails on anything not listed here, so a NEW high advisory still breaks the build.

GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx.reason: Prisma CLI config loader only (pinned by @prisma/config). Merges a config file we author; nothing in src/ imports the CLI.

GHSA-cqhc-2h57-wpxf.reason: Credential leak to a man in the middle. The app reaches the database on localhost. Re-examine if DATABASE_URL in production ever stops being localhost. No fix published.

GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr.reason: Auth-plugin downgrade; needs a hostile or intercepted database server. Same reachability argument as mariadb.
